c4q.text: What has happened to these two women?

sources.title: Musée du Louvre, collection record Ma 738, 'Plaque des Ergastines' (our translations)

c4a.text: Look: the neck stops at a break.

correction.tempting: The cloth rises at the shoulders.
correction.truth: The upper part is broken and the heads are lost.
correction.evidence: The crop; the Louvre record; the Strasbourg booklet (2022).

c4b.text: Yes. The top of the slab is broken away, and these two have lost their heads.

c4c.text: The heads are missing, not lowered.

correction.truth: The upper part is broken and the heads are lost.
correction.evidence: The crop; the Louvre record; the Strasbourg booklet (2022).

c4m.text: Broken at the top, heads lost.
